players.bio: Agustín Bouzat (born 28 March 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Houston Dynamo. Career Bouzat started his senior career in 2011 with Liniers, playing twelve times in Torneo Argentino B. He joined Boca Juniors of the Argentine Primera División in early 2012.
Antônio Carlos Cunha Capocasali Júnior (born 7 March 1993), known as Antônio Carlos, is a Brazilian footballer who plays as a central defender for Houston Dynamo.

José Artur de Lima Junior (born 11 March 1996), commonly known simply as Artur, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays for Major League Soccer club Houston Dynamo as a midfielder. Previously, he played in his native Brazil for São Paulo. While with the São Paulo U20s, Artur won the Copa do Brasil Sub-20 twice and the 2016 U-20 Copa Libertadores.

Benjamin Robert Olsen (born May 3, 1977) is an American sports executive, soccer coach, and former professional player who was formerly the president of Washington Spirit, a professional women's soccer club in the National Women's Soccer League (NWSL). He is currently the head coach of Houston Dynamo FC in Major League Soccer. Olsen is best known for his long-term association with D.C.

Blake Gillingham is an American professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for El Paso Locomotive FC in the USL Championship, on loan from Major League Soccer (MLS) club Houston Dynamo FC. Born on October 11, 2002, in San Jose, California, the 23-year-old recently moved to El Paso in July 2026 to secure more first-team playing time.

Diadie Samassékou (born 11 January 1996) is a Malian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer side Houston Dynamo. He also represents the Mali national team.
Duane Octavious Holmes (born November 6, 1994) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Houston Dynamo
Duncan MacAllister McGuire (born February 5, 2001) is an American soccer player who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club Orlando City.

Erik Sergiyovych Sviatchenko (Ukrainian: Ерік Сергійович Святченко; born 4 October 1991) is a Danish footballer who plays as a centre-back for MLS side Houston Dynamo. Sviatchenko was, during his youth playing years, captain of the FC Midtjylland squad.
Felipe de Andrade Vieira (born 29 May 2002), known as Felipe Andrade, is a Brazilian footballer who plays as a central defender for Houston Dynamo on loan from Fluminense.

Franco Negri (born 20 February 1995) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left midfielder for Major League Soccer club Houston Dynamo. Negri joined Primera División side San Lorenzo from hometown club San Martín in 2012. On 22 August 2016, fellow Primera División team Quilmes completed the loan signing of Negri.
Gilberto Rivera is an American professional soccer player who plays as a central midfielder for the USL Championship club Phoenix Rising FC, on loan from Houston Dynamo 2.

Guilherme Augusto Vieira dos Santos (born 13 April 1995), simply known as Guilherme, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Houston Dynamo. Career Grêmio Guilherme was born in São Paulo, and joined Grêmio's youth setup in May 2014, from Cotia , after a trial period.

Héctor Miguel Herrera López (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 19 April 1990) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as midfielder for Major League Soccer club Houston Dynamo. Herrera began his career with Pachuca in 2011 and spent three years at the club before joining FC Porto.

Ibrahim Aliyu (born 16 January 2002) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Houston Dynamo. Club career Lokomotiva Zagreb Aliyu went on trial with Croatian club NK Lokomotiva Zagreb in January 2020. On 9 February the 18 year old signed with the club. He spent the remainder of the 2019–20 season playing with the youth teams.
Jack Ryan McGlynn (born July 7, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Stoke City and the United States national team.

James "Jimmy" Maurer (born October 14, 1988) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Houston Dynamo. Maurer attended college at the University of South Carolina and was the starting Goalkeeper for four years. During his four-year career Maurer started all 78 games for the Gamecocks.

Jonathan Henry Bond (born 19 May 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Houston Dynamo. Bond has played internationally for Wales at under-17 and under-19 levels; he has also been called up to the under-21 and senior teams and the England under-21 squad having chosen to change his international allegiance in 2013.
Lawrence Ennali (born 7 March 2002) is a German professional footballer who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Houston Dynamo.
Lucas Halter (born 2 May 2000) is a Brazilian footballer who plays as a centre-back for Houston Dynamo.
Lyle Brent Foster is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Burnley and the South Africa national team.
Marcelo Josemir Saracchi Pintos is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Major League Soccer club Houston Dynamo, and the Uruguay national team.

Mateusz Piotr Bogusz (born 22 August 2001) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer side Houston Dynamo and the Poland national team. Bogusz started his career at Ekstraklasa side Ruch Chorzów, before signing for Leeds United in January 2019.

Nicholas Bungal "Nick" Markanich (born December 26, 1999), is an American professional soccer player who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club Houston Dynamo, on loan from Segunda División club CD Castellón.

Ondřej Lingr (born 7 October 1998) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer club Houston Dynamo and the Czech Republic national team. Lingr made his Czech First League debut for Karviná on 12 May 2017 in a game against Sparta Prague.
Samuel Marqus Lloyd Vines (born May 31, 1999) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a left-back for Major League Soccer club Houston Dynamo.
